title: ...help a conscious adult who is choking
desc: Perform abdominal thrusts to clear obstructed airway safely.
todos: Ask 'Are you choking?' â€” if they cannot speak, cough, or breathe, act immediately.
Stand behind person, lean them forward slightly, and give 5 sharp back blows between shoulder blades.
Wrap arms around waist, place fist just above navel, and deliver 5 quick inward/upward abdominal thrusts.
Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until object is dislodged.
Call 911 immediately if person loses consciousness and begin CPR.
